content:
{'Apple 已經發佈第六個 iOS 27 開發者測試版本。iOS 27 beta 6 延續 Apple 今夏嘅 beta 週期，預計九月正式公開發佈後我哋會更新手上嘅裝置，並同大家分享新發現。': "Apple has released the sixth developer beta of iOS 27. iOS 27 beta 6 continues Apple's summer beta cycle, and we plan to update our devices after the public release in September and share new findings."}

{'Apple 發佈第六個 iOS 27 開發者測試版': 'Apple Releases Sixth iOS 27 Developer Beta'}

{'第六個開發者 beta 版而家可以透過合資格 iPhone 嘅「設定」app 下載。如果你已經登記咗 Apple Developer Program，可以去「設定」>「一般」>「軟件更新」>「Beta 更新」，然後揀選 iOS 27 開發者 Beta。': 'The sixth developer beta is now available for download through the Settings app on eligible iPhones. If you are enrolled in the Apple Developer Program, head to Settings > General > Software Update > Beta Updates, then select the iOS 27 Developer Beta.'}

{'今日發佈嘅開發者 beta 版好大機會成為 iOS 27 公開 beta 4。正式版將會喺下個月推出畀所有用戶。': 'The developer beta released today will most likely become iOS 27 public beta 4. The official version will be released to all users next month.'}

{'同所有 beta 軟件一樣，大家安裝後仍可能會遇到 bug、電池續航下降、app 相容性問題以及其他唔完善嘅情況。': 'As with all beta software, users may still encounter bugs, reduced battery life, app compatibility issues, and other rough edges after installation.'}

{'iOS 27 主打 Siri AI': 'iOS 27 Centers on Siri AI'}

{'iOS 27 可說是 Apple 至今最注重 AI 嘅 iPhone 更新之一。最大嘅改動係 Siri AI——由新一代 Apple Intelligence 同全新 Apple Foundation Models 驅動嘅重新打造嘅智能助手。': "iOS 27 is arguably Apple's most AI-focused iPhone update to date. The biggest change is Siri AI — a rebuilt assistant powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence and new Apple Foundation Models."}

{'Siri AI 帶嚟更豐富嘅對話、個人化脈絡、更廣闊嘅世界知識、螢幕畫面感知，以及跨系統嘅更深層 app 操作。': 'Siri AI delivers richer conversations, personalized context, broader world knowledge, on-screen awareness, and deeper app actions across the system.'}

{'喺 iPhone 上，Siri AI 仲會有新嘅視覺體驗，配合「動態島」運作，並且新增一個專屬嘅 Siri app，方便用戶喺唔同裝置之間翻睇對話紀錄。': 'On iPhone, Siri AI also gets a new visual experience that works with the Dynamic Island, plus a dedicated Siri app that makes it easy to revisit conversation history across devices.'}

{'視覺智慧功能亦加入 Siri，包括「相機」app 內嘅全新 Siri 模式，以及影響 iPhone 相機控制嘅改進。': 'Visual intelligence features also come to Siri, including a new Siri mode inside the Camera app and improvements affecting the iPhone Camera Control.'}

{'Apple Intelligence 亦正擴展至更多 app。iOS 27 為「相片」、Safari、「密碼」、「郵件」、「訊息」、電話、「捷徑」、「家居」等加入 AI 驅動嘅改進。正如我哋早前拆解 Apple 全新 Foundation Models 嘅文章中提到，部分功能會喺裝置上運行，其他則透過 Private Cloud Compute 處理。': "Apple Intelligence is also expanding to more apps. iOS 27 adds AI-powered improvements across Photos, Safari, Passwords, Mail, Messages, Phone, Shortcuts, Home, and more. As we covered in our earlier teardown of Apple's new Foundation Models, some features run on-device while others are handled through Private Cloud Compute."}

{'更多 iOS 27 功能與改動': 'More iOS 27 Features and Changes'}

{'除咗 Siri 同 Apple Intelligence 之外，iOS 27 仲包含多項 iPhone 專屬改動。Apple 進一步打磨去年推出嘅 Liquid Glass 設計，包括新增 Liquid Glass 透明度滑桿，方便調整系統介面嘅外觀。': 'Beyond Siri and Apple Intelligence, iOS 27 includes a number of iPhone-specific changes. Apple has further refined the Liquid Glass design introduced last year, including a new Liquid Glass transparency slider to tweak the look of the system interface.'}

{'同時亦有多項效能改進，包括 app 啟動速度、「相片」載入、低電量模式開啟相機、AirDrop 傳輸，以及 Wi-Fi 與流動網絡切換等方面。': 'There are also performance improvements covering app launch speeds, Photos loading, opening the camera in Low Power Mode, AirDrop transfers, and Wi-Fi to cellular handoffs.'}

{'其他 iPhone 改動包括：「相片」加入關鍵詞同星級評分、自訂投影片播放、更流暢嘅相機操作、「訊息」可連續發送、FaceTime 雙鏡頭錄影、AirPods 自訂 EQ、新增復原選項、更方便嘅 Apple Pay 切換信用卡，以及 AI 生成嘅桌布製作功能。': 'Other iPhone changes include keywords and star ratings in Photos, custom slideshow playback, smoother camera operation, consecutive sends in Messages, dual-camera FaceTime recording, custom EQ for AirPods, new recovery options, easier Apple Pay card switching, and AI-generated wallpaper creation.'}

{'我哋而家正在安裝 iOS 27 beta 6，稍後會同大家更新任何值得留意嘅改動。與此同時，你可以喺 Apple 嘅 keynote 列表中重溫 iOS 27 嘅所有新內容。': "We're currently installing iOS 27 beta 6 and will update you with anything noteworthy shortly. In the meantime, you can revisit everything new in iOS 27 through our Apple keynote hub."}

{'發現今次 iOS 27 beta 6 有任何改動嗎？歡迎喺下方留言同我哋講！': 'Spotted any changes in this iOS 27 beta 6? Let us know in the comments below!'}

{'盡情發揮你 Apple 產品嘅威力': 'Get the most out of your Apple gear'}
